title: Crab: A Unified Audio-Visual Scene Understanding Model with Explicit Cooperation

layout.note: A central yellow-glow box with the crab and the word MLLMs, a task header with a thick down arrow above it and a colour legend below it; four tinted cards in the corners (temporal and spatial at the top, spatio-temporal reasoning and pixel-level at the bottom), each with a coloured title tab on its top edge and a colour-matched dotted arrow from the hub. Inside a card: user icon and prompt, input video with waveform, and the output at the right or below.

lesson: Show a unified model as a central hub with one colour-coded card per task: each card pairs a user prompt with a real input and output, and the same colour runs through tab, tint, prompt, dotted arrow and legend; a mascot in the hub brands the model.
